accepted_decision.explanation: Identity bindings show session-red maps to A and session-blue maps to B. Policy permits A to access A and B to access B only. All four request_account observations returned status 200 with body error "not authorized" yet included object data for the requested selector. Own-account requests for session-red/A (obs-3) and session-blue/B (obs-5) should be allowed per policy but are reported not authorized while still returning object data. Cross-account requests session-red/B (obs-4) and session-blue/A (obs-6) should be denied per policy and are reported not authorized but also return object data, indicating data exposure despite authorization error. This mismatch between policy expectations and observed responses constitutes a violation.

explanation_review.reason: Identifies returned cross-account private data against established policy despite error label

Describe validation methods, controls, evidence requirements and criteria to confirm or reject a hypothesis; do not require completed target validation.

accepted_decision.explanation: Policy shows session-red (A) permitted A,B and session-blue (B) permitted B only. Observed request_account responses for all four session/account pairs return status 200 with body error "not authorized" and in three cases also return object data (owner/value). Own-account access for session-red/A (obs-3) and session-blue/B (obs-5) is denied despite policy allowing access, and cross-account access for session-red/B (obs-4) is denied despite policy allowing A to access B. This divergence between policy and observed access constitutes a violation.

explanation_review.reason: Claims permitted reads were denied despite returned authorized object data; error label overrides content

study_scope: Two unpaired synthetic task-controller observations; no causal benefit estimate

author_inspection.scope: Manual inspection of frozen generated guidance before reviewing task outcomes; no mutation or gate

observations.passage: Denied baseline: request with Identity A and a header value for an object known to be authorized for Identity B or otherwise prohibited per documented policy.
observations.concern: Being authorized for B does not establish denial for A; legitimate sharing is a counterexample. Policy language elsewhere reduces but does not eliminate this ambiguity.

observations.passage: Invalid-value controls behave as expected and do not produce the same data.
observations.concern: An invalid value returning the same prohibited data does not invalidate a demonstrated valid-selector policy violation. This unnecessary condition can suppress a supported finding.

observations.passage: Error page or generic denial consistent with documented policy.
observations.concern: Elsewhere content checks are required; a denial label in a body containing protected data must not override the actual disclosure. Review task reasoning, not only its final label.

author_inspection.interpretation: Single guide; improved authorship completion is not broad semantic-quality evidence. Preserve the guide unchanged for observation.
